meta.name: seo-maps
meta.description: Maps intelligence for local SEO — geo-grid rank tracking, GBP profile auditing via API, review intelligence across Google/Tripadvisor/Trustpilot, cross-platform NAP verification (Google/Bing/Apple/OSM), competitor radius mapping, and LocalBusiness schema generation from API data. Three-tier capability: free (Overpass + Geoapify), DataForSEO (full intelligence), DataForSEO + Google (maximum coverage). Use when user says "maps", "geo-grid", "rank tracking", "GBP audit", "review velocity", "competitor radius", "maps analysis", "local rank tracking", "Share of Local Voice", or "SoLV".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪本地搜索排名并审计商家资料
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要管理多个地点的本地搜索可见性
copy.tagline_en: Track local search rankings and audit business profiles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage local search visibility across multiple locations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能分析本地商家在地图平台（Google Maps、Bing、Apple、OSM）上的表现，包括排名追踪、资料审核、评论分析、NAP 一致性检查、竞争对手地图和结构化数据生成。
howto.when: 当用户提到“maps”、“geo-grid”、“rank tracking”、“GBP audit”等关键词，或要求进行地图分析、本地排名追踪时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个商家在Google Maps上的排名。
say.note: Claude 会进行地图排名扫描。

say.text: 检查一下这家店的Google Business Profile完整性。
对比这个商家在Google和Tripadvisor上的评论。
say.note: Claude 会进行跨平台评论分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can analyze local business presence on map platforms (Google Maps, Bing, Apple, OSM), including rank tracking, profile auditing, review analysis, NAP consistency checks, competitor mapping, and schema generation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like "maps", "geo-grid", "rank tracking", "GBP audit", or requests map analysis or local rank tracking.

say_en.text: Analyze this business's ranking on Google Maps.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a geo-grid rank scan.

say_en.text: Audit the Google Business Profile for this store.
say_en.note: Claude will run a GBP completeness audit.

say_en.text: Compare reviews for this business on Google and Tripadvisor.
say_en.note: Claude will do cross-platform review analysis.
